gloss: to be entranced; to be enraptured; to be spellbound

definitions.gloss: to be entranced; to be enraptured; to gaze dreamily
definitions.explanation: Describes a state of being so captivated by something beautiful, pleasant, or attractive that one becomes absorbed and loses awareness of surroundings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧うっとりした。
examples.english: I was entranced by the beautiful music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦うっとり→うっとり：05271_uttori⟧⟦{眺|なが}めていた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: I was gazing dreamily at the sunset sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦うっとり→うっとり：05271_uttori⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{聴|き}き{入|い}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The audience listened to her piano performance in rapt fascination.

notes:
Describes being captivated by beauty, elegance, or charm to the point of dreamy absorption. Always carries a positive connotation — the person is enchanted by something they find wonderful.

FORMS:
- うっとりする: verb form
- ⟦うっとり→うっとり：05271_uttori⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: adverbial (⟦うっとり→うっとり：05271_uttori⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧, to gaze enraptured)
- うっとりした⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧: an entranced expression
- うっとりするような: so beautiful as to entrance someone

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦うっとり→うっとり：05271_uttori⟧{見|み}とれる: to be so captivated one stares
- うっとりするほど⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧: so beautiful it entrances you
- うっとりした⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: dreamy eyes
- ⟦うっとり→うっとり：05271_uttori⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{聴|き}き{入|い}る: to listen in rapt attention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見|み}とれる: to be fascinated by looking at something — specifically visual; ⟦うっとり→うっとり：05271_uttori⟧ can apply to music, fragrance, etc.
- ⟦ぼんやりする→ぼんやりする：21687_bonyarisuru⟧: to be absent-minded, to space out — lacks the positive, enchanted nuance of ⟦うっとり→うっとり：05271_uttori⟧
- ⟦{陶酔|とうすい}→陶酔：06001_tousui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be intoxicated (figuratively) — more literary and formal
